visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a split-screen composition. The bottom half shows a real-life woman with a grey beanie, red scarf, and white sweater walking into a brown vintage-style telephone booth on a busy Tokyo street during the day. (2) The scene transitions; the woman is now standing in front of a white corner building with '葵ビル' inscribed on it. She turns her head to look directly at the camera with a slight smile. The background includes green foliage and street signs in soft daylight. (3) The woman is then seen from behind, running up a set of wide concrete stairs in an urban area, mimicking the movement of the animated character shown in the top half of the screen. (4) A close-up shot shows the woman's hand holding a bright red gerbera flower in front of a cafe entrance decorated with festive Japanese New Year wreaths. The lighting is warm and natural. (5) The woman is lying face down on a clean asphalt street in a narrow alleyway, holding the same red flower. She wears a grey coat over her white sweater. The top half shows the animated character in an identical pose. (6) The final sequence shows the woman in full cosplay as the character from the animation. She is standing on an escalator at night, illuminated by purple neon lights, followed by a pose on a metal staircase. She wears a white sleeveless shirt, black shorts, and a black choker.
